job.title: Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence Architect (Microsoft Fabric)
job.description:
Senior Data Platform Architect

About the Role

A confidential organization is seeking a Senior Data Platform Architect to design and build its enterprise data platform using Microsoft Fabric and Azure. This fully remote role will work with business, analytics, and technology teams to deliver data solutions that support a range of organizational functions.

The architect will establish the data warehouse, engineering workflows, pipelines, and models that support the organization’s analytics environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, SQL, Python, and integrating data from multiple source systems.

Work arrangement: Fully remote
Reports to: Director of Data & Analytics

Key Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end data architecture using Microsoft Fabric capabilities, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, and Dataflows Gen2.
  • Develop data models and schema definitions to support complex analytical workloads.
  • Build and maintain integrations with flat files, APIs, partner data feeds, and third-party SaaS platforms.
  • Support data quality, security, and compliance, including data lineage, classification, and access controls.
  • Establish and document architecture standards for folder structures, naming conventions, version control, CI/CD, and deployment workflows.
  • Improve platform reliability, cost efficiency, and governance through automation and monitoring.
  • Participate in data strategy reviews, architecture sessions, and cross-functional planning.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; a master’s degree is preferred.
  • 7+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or BI development, including 2+ years with Microsoft Fabric or Azure Synapse.
  • Experience designing data warehouses, dimensional models, and ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Proficiency in T-SQL and Python or PySpark.
  • Experience with Power BI, Azure Data Factory or Fabric Pipelines, OneLake, and Lakehouse architecture.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, webhooks, and partner data.
  • Familiarity with Delta Lake and Parquet optimization, including Z-ordering, partitioning, and compaction.
  • Knowledge of dimensional modeling, such as Kimball, and medallion architecture.
  • Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and data security.
  • Hands-on experience with Git and CI/CD for data solutions, preferably using Azure DevOps.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with dbt, Purview, and Power BI performance tuning.
  • Strong documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

Reasonable accommodations are available to applicants who need assistance during the application process.

Pay: $150,000 to $180,000 per year

job.title: Senior Security Platform Engineer
job.description:
Senior Cloud Infrastructure & Security Engineer

Location: New York City, NY
Employment Type: Contract

This is a highly technical, hands on role requiring a versatile engineer who can operate across cloud infrastructure, automation, security monitoring, incident response, and application security. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable troubleshooting complex production infrastructure issues, developing Terraform modules, tuning SIEM detection rules, and leading security investigations.

This individual will serve as a senior technical escalation point across multiple teams, helping ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of critical cloud environments and applications.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering

  • Design, manage, and maintain cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), primarily Terraform.
  • Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules across cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and networking issues involving load balancers, security groups, WAF, DNS, CDN, and containerized workloads.
  • Manage cloud identities, access permissions, service accounts, credentials, and secrets across multiple environments.
  • Support and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and developer tooling.
  • Evaluate, implement, and maintain cloud security and infrastructure monitoring solutions.
  • Provide senior level technical support and escalation for production infrastructure incidents.

Security Monitoring & Detection Engineering

  • Administer and optimize enterprise SIEM platforms, preferably Elastic Security.
  • Manage log ingestion pipelines, integrations, agents, and security monitoring configurations.
  • Develop, maintain, and tune security detection rules to improve threat visibility and reduce false positives.
  • Investigate logging issues, parsing errors, and gaps in monitoring coverage.
  • Integrate security alerts into operational workflows and incident response processes.
  • Maintain documentation for security monitoring architecture, detection logic, and operational procedures.

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for security incidents and complex investigations.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to SOC analysts and security team members.
  • Investigate suspicious authentication activity, account compromise, network threats, and unauthorized access.
  • Coordinate incident containment and remediation, including credential resets, session revocation, and access restrictions.
  • Develop and maintain incident response procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation.
  • Implement and optimize WAF rules and traffic filtering measures to mitigate malicious activity.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and security teams to identify root causes and implement long term solutions.

Identity & Access Management

  • Manage and improve identity and access controls across cloud platforms and enterprise applications.
  • Support identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or similar platforms.
  • Implement authentication security controls, including MFA, conditional access policies, and SSO.
  • Conduct access reviews, identity audits, and account reconciliation across environments.
  • Identify and remediate identity related security risks, including legacy authentication methods and excessive permissions.
  • Partner with IT and security leadership on identity governance and access management initiatives.

Application & AI Security

  • Partner with software engineering teams to identify and remediate application security vulnerabilities across web, mobile, and backend platforms.
  • Review application architecture and code for potential security risks involving authentication, authorization, API security, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets management.
  • Support application security practices across technologies such as React, React Native, Node.js, Java/Spring Boot, and Python/Flask.
  • Integrate security scanning and vulnerability management tools into development and CI/CD workflows.
  • Review findings from SAST, SCA, and cloud security tools, coordinating remediation with engineering teams.
  • Evaluate security considerations associated with AI/ML applications, LLM integrations, and internal AI tools.
  • Help establish security standards for AI applications, including access controls, data protection, prompt injection risks, and third party integrations.

Fraud & Payment Security

  • Collaborate with internal risk and payment teams to investigate suspicious transactions and potential payment fraud.
  • Assist with identifying and mitigating automated attacks, card testing, and fraudulent traffic.
  • Review payment security controls, fraud detection rules, and risk management configurations.
  • Support vulnerability remediation and security improvements across payment related applications and services.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Strong hands on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, including development and maintenance of reusable modules.
  • Experience managing production cloud infrastructure within AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar environments.
  • Hands on experience administering and optimizing a SIEM platform, ideally Elastic Security, including log ingestion, detection engineering, and alerting.
  • Strong networking fundamentals, including DNS, load balancers, WAF, CDN, network security controls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Experience with identity and access management platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or similar solutions.
  • Solid understanding of SSO, SAML, MFA, conditional access, and authentication security.
  • Demonstrated experience investigating and responding to cybersecurity incidents.
  • Familiarity with application security principles and the ability to review code and architecture for potential vulnerabilities.
  • Working knowledge of modern application technologies such as React, Node.js, Java, and Python.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across infrastructure, development, and security teams.
  • Ability to independently manage complex technical issues and serve as a senior escalation resource.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multicloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Azure.
  • Experience with containerized infrastructure and orchestration platforms such as ECS or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with cloud security posture management and vulnerability management tools such as Wiz, CrowdStrike, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience with security scanning solutions such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk, or SonarQube.
  • Hands on development or code review experience involving React Native, React, Node.js, Spring Boot, or Python/Flask.
  • Experience mentoring SOC analysts, security engineers, or junior infrastructure team members.
  • Familiarity with payment security, fraud detection systems, and payment gateway technologies.
  • Understanding of AI/LLM security risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, and model access controls.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior level, hands on engineer with a strong foundation in cloud infrastructure and platform engineering, combined with practical cybersecurity and incident response experience.

We are looking for someone who can move seamlessly between troubleshooting production infrastructure, improving cloud automation, investigating security threats, and collaborating with application development teams.

This individual should be technically curious, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of complex challenges rather than simply escalating them.

Success in this role requires a combination of deep technical expertise, strong troubleshooting instincts, security awareness, and the ability to collaborate across multiple engineering teams.

Pay: $48 per hour

We are seeking a Level 1 Help Desk Engineer to join the IT team of a leading organization in the fitness and wellness industry. This individual will provide technical support to corporate employees, field locations, and executive users while delivering exceptional customer service and a white glove support experience.

The ideal candidate is a personable, professional, and technically capable IT support professional who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and working in a fast paced environment. Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to providing a positive end user experience are essential.

This is a contract to hire opportunity with an anticipated conversion to a permanent position after approximately 12 months.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 1 technical support to corporate employees, remote locations, and executive users, ensuring a professional and responsive support experience.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, application, and connectivity issues both onsite and remotely.
  • Support Windows and macOS desktops and laptops, printers, mobile devices, Microsoft Exchange, and internal applications.

job.description:
Role Overview
This is a SOC (Security Operations Center) Cybersecurity Engineer. The role sits at the senior level and serves as the first escalation point above the Tier 1 analyst.
Key Responsibilities
The engineer will work across two distinct security domains: IT security (covering endpoint protection, SaaS application security, and SIEM log management) and OT (operational technology) security, which encompasses the shop floor and development team environments. Day-to-day duties include responding to and validating email phishing alerts (distinguishing false from true positives), supporting incident response escalations, and driving vulnerability management by coordinating with systems teams to remediate OS-level vulnerabilities. The role also requires communicating directly with leadership and ownership, including the ability to present and explain security issues clearly in executive settings.
Experience & Qualifications
Minimum 4–5 years of hands-on SOC engineering experience is required — not analyst experience.
Technical Environment
The organization is standardized on Rapid 7 and Palo Alto for security tooling. Candidates must have meaningful SIEM and endpoint tool experience. The company is a Microsoft shop, so familiarity with Microsoft security tools is valued; the SC-200 certification is a nice-to-have but not required and can be taught.
Compensation
Target range is $115,000–$125,000.
Work Schedule & Location
Standard hours are 8:00 AM–5:00 PM, with flexibility. The role is primarily on-site (5 days), but hybrid arrangements are open to discussion as an exception for the right candidate. After-hours on-call incidents are rare — the company has a third-party incident response partner for overnight coverage — but the engineer would be the first point of contact if escalated.

Benefits: medical, dental, vision and life insurance, a 401(k) plan and paid time off.

job.description:
Job Title

Security Engineering Manager

About the Opportunity

Are you a hands-on technical leader ready to shape the defensive architecture of a modern, cloud-first infrastructure? We are seeking a Security Engineering Manager to guide a high-performing team of engineers while driving application security and cloud protection strategies across our modern software ecosystem. In this role, you will bridge strategic security vision with deep technical execution, empowering product and engineering teams to build fast without sacrificing security.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Guidance & Architecture: Provide direct technical oversight for complex security challenges, conduct thorough architecture reviews, and maintain active hands-on involvement with cloud defensive configurations.
  • Program Direction: Drive the continuous evolution of our application security and cloud posture initiatives throughout every stage of the software development lifecycle.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and cultivate a dedicated team of security engineers, fostering a high-ownership culture focused on professional growth and technical rigor.
  • Strategic Delivery: Plan, track, and execute security engineering initiatives from design through deployment, guaranteeing alignment with broader organizational risk priorities.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product and DevOps leaders to embed preventative security standards directly into engineering roadmaps and development workflows.
  • Risk Reduction: Proactively identify infrastructure vulnerabilities, remove operational roadblocks, and maintain momentum on remediation efforts across all engineering domains.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive information security experience, with specialized expertise in AppSec, DevSecOps, or cloud infrastructure defense.
  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing technical teams while successfully delivering complex security projects.
  • Deep technical mastery of secure software development practices, CI/CD pipeline protections, secrets administration, and application vulnerabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

AV Support Technician

Location: New Jersey
Work Type: On-Site / Flexible / As Needed
AV Professionals Wanted — Join Our Network

We’re expanding our network of AV professionals across New Jersey to support a variety of corporate audiovisual and collaboration technology needs.
This is a great opportunity for AV technicians who enjoy hands-on work, troubleshooting technology, supporting live meetings, and working in professional environments.
Some assignments may be recurring and scheduled, while others may be ad-hoc, event-based, or on-call depending on the needs of our clients. This flexibility makes the opportunity a great fit for experienced AV technicians looking to pick up additional work, build relationships with new organizations, or stay active in the AV industry.
You’ll have the opportunity to work with modern collaboration technology and support everything from conference rooms and video conferencing to live events and webcasting.
What You Could Be Supporting
Depending on the assignment, responsibilities may include:

  • Supporting in-person, hybrid, and virtual meetings
  • Providing on-site AV and end-user support
  • Setting up and testing conference rooms before meetings and events
  • Troubleshooting audio, video, display, and connectivity issues
  • Supporting Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Webex, and other collaboration platforms
  • Performing basic troubleshooting and system fault isolation
  • Supporting live meetings, presentations, and virtual events
  • Assisting with webcasting and streaming events
  • Performing preventative maintenance on AV equipment
  • Supporting equipment installation, removal, and replacement
  • Updating software and maintaining AV systems
  • Providing hands-on assistance and training to end users
  • Coordinating with vendors and other technical teams when issues need to be escalated
  • Documenting service activity, troubleshooting steps, and completed work
  • Helping ensure meeting spaces are ready and fully operational

The Type of AV Professionals We're Looking For
We’re casting a wide net and are interested in connecting with AV professionals at different stages of their careers.
You may be a:

  • AV Technician
  • Audio Visual Technician

Not every AV opportunity looks the same — and that's the point.
Our team works with organizations that need reliable AV professionals they can count on, whether that's for ongoing support, a specific project, an important meeting, a live event, or an unexpected technical issue.
That means opportunities can range from scheduled on-site support to occasional ad-hoc assignments, depending on your experience, availability, and location.
